name: Personalized Pottery Mug
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from high-quality pottery, this mug features a beautiful speckled glaze and a distinct two-tone design. 
  • The top portion is finished in a smooth, vibrant matte or glossy glaze, while the bottom showcases a textured, earthy base for a natural look and feel. 
  • The sturdy construction ensures durability for daily use, providing a premium weight and feel in your hand.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed for the perfect grip and capacity, the mug follows a balanced architectural silhouette with priority on imperial units:

  • Height: 3.43 in (8.7 cm)
  • Top Diameter: 3.43 in (8.7 cm)
  • Total Width (including handle): 4.33 in (11 cm)
  • Capacity: ≈ 12 oz

 

Printing Technology:

UV DTF printing technology with a protective glossy finish that enhances color and durability. 

 

Functionality Use:
  • Ergonomic Handle: A large, easy-to-grip handle ensures comfort, even when the mug is full.
  • Versatile Tones: Available in four sophisticated colors: Deep Teal, White, Cream, and Pink.
  • Heat Retention: The thick pottery walls help maintain the temperature of your beverage longer than standard ceramic.
  • NOTE: To maintain its design quality over time, we suggest hand washing and allowing it to air dry, no microwave or dishwasher using

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This pottery Mug makes a thoughtful and practical gift for coffee lovers, tea enthusiasts, family members, friends, coworkers, teachers, or anyone who enjoys stylish drinkware. Perfect for birthdays, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, Christmas, anniversaries, housewarmings, weddings, and other special occasions.


Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Pottery Mug
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
